sources.said: convened a high-level bilateral meeting to accelerate the implementation of Sierra Leone’s first-ever National Film Policy. … The National Film Policy is designed to strengthen Sierra Leone’s creative industry, attract investment opportunities, and showcase the nation’s rich cultural heritage on the global stage.
